name: Schedule Automated Backup
description: Set up automated backups to protect your data

steps.title: Open Backup Settings
steps.description: Navigate to the system settings and select the Backup option.

steps.title: Create New Schedule
steps.description: Click the 'New Schedule' button to create a new backup schedule.

steps.title: Set Frequency
steps.description: Choose how often backups should run (daily, weekly, monthly).

steps.title: Select Backup Time
steps.description: Pick a time when system usage is typically low for the backup to run.

steps.title: Choose Backup Location
steps.description: Specify where the backup files should be stored.

steps.title: Enable Schedule
steps.description: Toggle the schedule to active and save your settings.
